t: The Brenner Limescale Remover 1Ltr is a professional liquid formula designed to quickly dissolve tough scale deposits. This ready-to-use bathroom limescale remover is ideal for commercial plumbers and facility managers maintaining washrooms, showers, and taps. Powered by citric acid, the fast-acting liquid breaks down stubborn build-up and clears water marks without harsh scrubbing. The fragrance-free and taint-free solution also leaves an invisible barrier to reduce future limescale accumulation on chrome and ceramic surfaces, keeping fixtures cleaner for longer.
b: Leaves No Fragrance or Taint Behind
